slides.body: American blockchain analysis firm Chainalysis has confirmed a cybersecurity incident affecting its internal tools. An external actor successfully accessed non-sensitive customer identity data, indicating a breach of personal information. However, the company clarified that the intrusion did not compromise critical assets such as investigation content, authentication credentials, or session tokens. While the exposed data is deemed non-sensitive, users are advised to stay alert for potential misuse or targeted communications.
